notes: Raise a streak pet: pick and name an egg, tap it to hatch, and watch it grow, with pop-ups and a Pet entry in the Home menu.
A new Fun theme with candy colors and chunky buttons, and a theme and pet step for new accounts.
Add e-wallet accounts like GCash and Maya, and hold several currencies in one bank account.
The More tab starts higher, and signing in with Google no longer reports a false error.
Crash reports now say where in the code a crash happened, without error messages or your data.
